tasks.PolynomialRemainderCalculation: Calculate the remainder of a polynomial when divided by another polynomial using the Remainder Theorem and properties of polynomials.

answer: The remainder when f(x) = x^10 + 5x^9 - 8x^8 + 7x^7 - x^6 - 12x^5 + 4x^4 - 8x^3 + 12x^2 - 5x - 5 is divided by x^2 - 1 is -6x + 3.
